```{r}
find_project_root <- function(start) {
  path <- normalizePath(start, winslash = "/", mustWork = FALSE)
  repeat {
    if (file.exists(file.path(path, ".unaltraweb", "computations.yml"))) {
      return(path)
    }
    parent <- dirname(path)
    if (identical(parent, path)) {
      stop("Project root not found: missing .unaltraweb/computations.yml")
    }
    path <- parent
  }
}

root <- find_project_root(getwd())
library(ggplot2)

climate <- read.csv(
  file.path(root, "_practices/tigit-projecte-territorial/data/raw/clima-vila-seca-mitjanes-1991-2020.csv"),
  fileEncoding = "UTF-8",
  stringsAsFactors = FALSE
)
climate <- climate[order(climate$month_number), ]
month_labels <- c("Gen", "Feb", "Març", "Abr", "Maig", "Juny", "Jul", "Ag", "Set", "Oct", "Nov", "Des")
climate$month_axis <- factor(month_labels, levels = month_labels)

stopifnot(
  nrow(climate) == 12,
  identical(climate$month_number, 1:12),
  abs(sum(climate$mean_precipitation_mm) - climate$annual_precipitation_mm[1]) <= 0.2,
  abs(mean(climate$mean_temperature_c) - climate$annual_mean_temperature_c[1]) <= 0.1
)

climate$gaussen_temperature_mm <- 2 * climate$mean_temperature_c
climate$is_dry <- climate$mean_precipitation_mm < climate$gaussen_temperature_mm
dry_months <- climate[climate$is_dry, ]

stopifnot(identical(dry_months$month_number, 6:8))

fig <- ggplot(climate, aes(x = month_number)) +
  geom_rect(
    data = dry_months,
    aes(
      xmin = month_number - 0.5,
      xmax = month_number + 0.5,
      ymin = 0,
      ymax = 100
    ),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    fill = "#FBE6D6",
    color = NA
  ) +
  geom_col(
    aes(y = mean_precipitation_mm, fill = "Precipitació"),
    width = 0.72
  ) +
  geom_line(
    aes(y = gaussen_temperature_mm, color = "Temperatura", group = 1),
    linewidth = 0.95
  ) +
  geom_point(
    aes(y = gaussen_temperature_mm, color = "Temperatura"),
    fill = "white",
    shape = 21,
    stroke = 0.8,
    size = 2.5
  ) +
  annotate(
    "text",
    x = 7,
    y = 92,
    label = "Mesos secs: juny–agost\nP < 2T",
    color = "#8C3B13",
    fontface = "bold",
    size = 4.2
  ) +
  scale_x_continuous(
    breaks = 1:12,
    labels = month_labels,
    expand = expansion(add = 0.55)
  ) +
  scale_y_continuous(
    name = "Precipitació mitjana mensual (mm)",
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, 20),
    expand = expansion(mult = c(0, 0)),
    sec.axis = sec_axis(
      transform = ~ . / 2,
      name = "Temperatura mitjana (°C)",
      breaks = seq(0, 50, 10)
    )
  ) +
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("Precipitació" = "#2C7FB8")) +
  scale_color_manual(values = c("Temperatura" = "#C0392B")) +
  labs(
    title = "Climograma de Vila-seca: mitjanes mensuals (1991–2020)",
    x = NULL,
    fill = NULL,
    color = NULL
  ) +
  guides(
    fill = guide_legend(order = 1),
    color = guide_legend(order = 2)
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(
    panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    panel.grid.major.y = element_line(color = "#e0e6eb", linewidth = 0.35),
    axis.line = element_line(color = "#17202a", linewidth = 0.4),
    axis.ticks = element_line(color = "#17202a", linewidth = 0.3),
    axis.title = element_text(face = "bold", color = "#17202a"),
    axis.text = element_text(size = 13, color = "#52616b"),
    axis.text.x = element_text(size = 10.5, face = "plain", margin = margin(t = 5)),
    plot.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold", color = "#17202a", hjust = 0),
    legend.position = "top",
    legend.text = element_text(color = "#17202a"),
    legend.key.width = grid::unit(1.5, "lines"),
    plot.margin = margin(8, 12, 8, 12)
  )

output <- file.path(root, "assets/img/data-visualization/climograph-vila-seca-1991-2020.svg")
dir.create(dirname(output), showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)
ggsave(output, fig, width = 7.2, height = 5.1, device = svglite::svglite)
```
